name: Statement Of Investment Fund Transactions 2
definition: Information about a statement of investment fund transactions.

StatementGeneralDetails.name: Statement General Details
StatementGeneralDetails.definition: General information related to the investment fund statement of transactions that is being cancelled.

InvestmentAccountDetails.name: Investment Account Details
InvestmentAccountDetails.definition: Information related to an investment account of the statement that is being cancelled.

TransactionOnAccount.name: Transaction On Account
TransactionOnAccount.definition: Creation/cancellation of investment units on the books of the fund or its designated agent, as a result of executing an investment fund order.

SubAccountDetails.name: Sub Account Details
SubAccountDetails.definition: Sub-account of the safekeeping or investment account.

Extension.name: Extension
Extension.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.

TransactionOnAccountOrSubAccountDetailsR.definition: If StatementGeneralDetails/ActivityIndicator is "true" or "1" (Yes), then either TransactionOnAccount or SubAccountDetails must be present. If StatementGeneralDetails/ActivityIndicator is "false" or "0" (No), then TransactionOnAccount and SubAccountDetails are not allowed.
